golden.statementScope: whole statements intersecting the selected order

schema.name: commerce_aftersale_requests
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE commerce_aftersale_requests(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner TEXT NOT NULL,environment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(environment='sandbox'),order_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES commerce_orders(id),request_id TEXT NOT NULL,fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,reason TEXT NOT NULL,quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',created INTEGER NOT NULL,updated INTEGER NOT NULL,UNIQUE(owner,environment,request_id))

schema.name: commerce_carts
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE commerce_carts(owner TEXT NOT NULL,environment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(environment='sandbox'),data TEXT NOT NULL,updated INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(owner,environment))

schema.name: commerce_config
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE commerce_config(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,data TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: commerce_entitlements
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE commerce_entitlements(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner TEXT NOT NULL,environment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(environment='sandbox'),order_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES commerce_orders(id),item_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES commerce_order_items(id),content_id TEXT NOT NULL,type TEXT NOT NULL,quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,remaining INTEGER NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('active','revoked')),created INTEGER NOT NULL,updated INTEGER NOT NULL)

schema.name: commerce_inventory_events
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE commerce_inventory_events(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner TEXT NOT NULL,environment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(environment='sandbox'),order_id TEXT NOT NULL,item_id TEXT NOT NULL,sku_id TEXT NOT NULL,quantity_delta INTEGER NOT NULL,reason TEXT NOT NULL,created INTEGER NOT NULL)

schema.name: commerce_order_items
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE commerce_order_items(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,order_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES commerce_orders(id),sku_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES commerce_skus(id),product_id TEXT NOT NULL,title TEXT NOT NULL,type TEXT NOT NULL,quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(quantity>0),price_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,currency TEXT NOT NULL,unit_shipping_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,unit_tax_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,content_id TEXT NOT NULL,price_version INTEGER NOT NULL,refunded_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(refunded_quantity>=0 AND refunded_quantity<=quantity),snapshot_data TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',UNIQUE(order_id,sku_id))

schema.name: commerce_orders
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE commerce_orders(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner TEXT NOT NULL,environment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(environment='sandbox'),request_id TEXT NOT NULL,fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,payment_status TEXT NOT NULL,fulfillment_status TEXT NOT NULL,aftersale_status TEXT NOT NULL,currency TEXT NOT NULL,subtotal_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,shipping_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,tax_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,total_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,refunded_minor INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,shipping_address TEXT NOT NULL,tracking TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',reserved_until INTEGER NOT NULL,created INTEGER NOT NULL,updated INTEGER NOT NULL,UNIQUE(owner,environment,request_id))

schema.name: commerce_payment_events
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE commerce_payment_events(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner TEXT NOT NULL,environment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(environment='sandbox'),order_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES commerce_orders(id),request_id TEXT NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('sandbox_pay','refund')),fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,amount_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,currency TEXT NOT NULL,items TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status='applied'),created INTEGER NOT NULL,UNIQUE(owner,environment,kind,request_id))

schema.name: commerce_prices
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE commerce_prices(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,sku_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES commerce_skus(id),version INTEGER NOT NULL,price_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,currency TEXT NOT NULL,created INTEGER NOT NULL,UNIQUE(sku_id,version))

schema.name: commerce_products
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE commerce_products(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,title TEXT NOT NULL,description TEXT NOT NULL,type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(type IN ('digital','physical','membership')),environment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(environment IN ('sandbox','production')),status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('draft','published','archived')),version INTEGER NOT NULL,content_id TEXT NOT NULL,shipping_countries TEXT NOT NULL,shipping_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(shipping_minor>=0),tax_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(tax_minor>=0),mutation_id TEXT NOT NULL,created INTEGER NOT NULL,updated INTEGER NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}')

schema.name: commerce_reservations
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE commerce_reservations(order_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES commerce_orders(id),sku_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES commerce_skus(id),quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(quantity>0),state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('held','consumed','released')),PRIMARY KEY(order_id,sku_id))

schema.name: commerce_skus
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE commerce_skus(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,product_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES commerce_products(id),sku TEXT NOT NULL,environment TEXT NOT NULL,price_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(price_minor>=0),currency TEXT NOT NULL,stock INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(stock>=0),reserved INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(reserved>=0 AND reserved<=stock),version INTEGER NOT NULL,UNIQUE(environment,sku))

schema.name: commission_adjustments
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE commission_adjustments(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,ledger_id TEXT NOT NULL,beneficiary TEXT NOT NULL,currency TEXT NOT NULL,refunded_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,amount_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_minor>=0),target_minor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(target_minor>=0),status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('applied','pending_recovery','reserved','offset_booked')),reason TEXT NOT NULL,source_event TEXT NOT NULL,created INTEGER NOT NULL,UNIQUE(ledger_id,refunded_quantity))

schema.name: commission_attributions
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE commission_attributions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner TEXT NOT NULL,code TEXT NOT NULL,beneficiary TEXT NOT NULL,priority INTEGER NOT NULL,created INTEGER NOT NULL,valid_until INTEGER NOT NULL,request_id TEXT NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(owner,request_id))

schema.name: commission_config
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE commission_config(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,data TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: commission_events
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE commission_events(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,actor TEXT NOT NULL,action TEXT NOT NULL,target TEXT NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL,created INTEGER NOT NULL)

schema.name: commission_facts
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE commission_facts(item_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,data TEXT NOT NULL,updated INTEGER NOT NULL,actor TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: commission_grants
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE commission_grants(user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,permission TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(permission IN ('business','finance','support')),updated INTEGER NOT NULL,actor TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: commission_invites
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE commission_invites(code TEXT PRIMARY KEY,beneficiary TEXT NOT NULL,valid_until INTEGER NOT NULL,priority INTEGER NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('active','revoked')),created INTEGER NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: commission_ledger
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE commission_ledger(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,order_id TEXT NOT NULL,item_id TEXT NOT NULL,beneficiary TEXT NOT NULL,rule_id TEXT NOT NULL,rule_version INTEGER NOT NULL,currency TEXT NOT NULL,quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,refunded_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,base_minor INTEGER,amount_minor INTEGER,net_minor INTEGER,status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('waiting_facts','pending_confirmation','frozen','payable','statement_pending','settled_bookkeeping','revoked')),freeze_until INTEGER NOT NULL,payment_event TEXT NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL,created INTEGER NOT NULL,updated INTEGER NOT NULL,UNIQUE(item_id,rule_id,rule_version,beneficiary))

schema.name: commission_payments
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE commission_payments(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,statement_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,request_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,data TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status='sandbox_registered'),created INTEGER NOT NULL,actor TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: commission_rules
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE commission_rules(rule_id TEXT NOT NULL,version INTEGER NOT NULL,product_id TEXT NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('promotion','author')),effective INTEGER NOT NULL,created INTEGER NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(rule_id,version))

schema.name: commission_snapshots
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE commission_snapshots(item_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,order_id TEXT NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL,created INTEGER NOT NULL)

schema.name: commission_statement_lines
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE commission_statement_lines(statement_id TEXT NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('earning','recovery')),source_id TEXT NOT NULL,amount_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(statement_id,kind,source_id))

schema.name: commission_statements
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE commission_statements(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,beneficiary TEXT NOT NULL,currency TEXT NOT NULL,total_minor INTEGER NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('awaiting_approval','approved','booked','cancelled')),version INTEGER NOT NULL,creator TEXT NOT NULL,approver TEXT NOT NULL,period_from INTEGER NOT NULL,period_to INTEGER NOT NULL,created INTEGER NOT NULL,updated INTEGER NOT NULL)

schema.name: contents
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE contents(kind TEXT,id TEXT,status TEXT)

schema.name: membership_channel_mappings
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE membership_channel_mappings(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,environment TEXT NOT NULL,channel TEXT NOT NULL,external_product_id TEXT NOT NULL,plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,plan_version INTEGER NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,created INTEGER NOT NULL,updated INTEGER NOT NULL,UNIQUE(environment,channel,external_product_id))

schema.name: membership_events
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE membership_events(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner TEXT NOT NULL,environment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(environment='sandbox'),subscription_id TEXT NOT NULL,request_id TEXT NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL,fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL,created INTEGER NOT NULL,UNIQUE(owner,environment,request_id))

schema.name: membership_order_snapshots
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE membership_order_snapshots(item_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner TEXT NOT NULL,environment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(environment='sandbox'),order_id TEXT NOT NULL,plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,plan_version INTEGER NOT NULL,group_id TEXT NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL,subscription_id TEXT,payment_event_id TEXT,period_start INTEGER,period_end INTEGER,state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',created INTEGER NOT NULL)

schema.name: membership_plan_versions
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE membership_plan_versions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,version INTEGER NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL,created INTEGER NOT NULL,UNIQUE(plan_id,version))

schema.name: membership_plans
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE membership_plans(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,environment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(environment IN ('sandbox','production')),status TEXT NOT NULL,version INTEGER NOT NULL,sku_id TEXT NOT NULL,group_id TEXT NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL,created INTEGER NOT NULL,updated INTEGER NOT NULL,UNIQUE(environment,sku_id))

schema.name: membership_purchase_locks
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE membership_purchase_locks(owner TEXT NOT NULL,environment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(environment='sandbox'),group_id TEXT NOT NULL,order_id TEXT NOT NULL,subscription_id TEXT,expires INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(owner,environment,group_id))

schema.name: membership_subscriptions
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE membership_subscriptions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner TEXT NOT NULL,environment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(environment='sandbox'),group_id TEXT NOT NULL,original_item_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,current_item_id TEXT NOT NULL,plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,plan_version INTEGER NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('trialing','active','renewal_failed','grace','paused','past_due','cancelled_active','expired','revoked')),auto_renew INTEGER NOT NULL,period_start INTEGER NOT NULL,period_end INTEGER NOT NULL,grace_end INTEGER,trial_end INTEGER,next_charge_at INTEGER,cancelled_at INTEGER,version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,created INTEGER NOT NULL,updated INTEGER NOT NULL)

schema.name: settings
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE settings(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,data TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: users
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE users(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,role TEXT)

schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER commerce_order_closed AFTER UPDATE OF status ON commerce_orders WHEN OLD.status='awaiting_payment' AND NEW.status='closed' BEGIN UPDATE commerce_reservations SET state='released' WHERE order_id=NEW.id AND state='held'; END

schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER commerce_reserve_consume AFTER UPDATE OF state ON commerce_reservations WHEN OLD.state='held' AND NEW.state='consumed' BEGIN UPDATE commerce_skus SET reserved=reserved-NEW.quantity,stock=stock-NEW.quantity WHERE id=NEW.sku_id; END

schema.name: commerce_reserve_hold
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER commerce_reserve_hold AFTER INSERT ON commerce_reservations WHEN NEW.state='held' BEGIN UPDATE commerce_skus SET reserved=reserved+NEW.quantity WHERE id=NEW.sku_id; END

schema.name: commerce_reserve_release
schema.sql: CREATE TRIGGER commerce_reserve_release AFTER UPDATE OF state ON commerce_reservations WHEN OLD.state='held' AND NEW.state='released' BEGIN UPDATE commerce_skus SET reserved=reserved-NEW.quantity WHERE id=NEW.sku_id; END
